description: This file defines a Java interface 'FtpClientInterface' that specifies methods for FTP client operations such as connecting, copying files, listing directory contents, setting transfer modes, and closing the connection.

classes.name: FtpClientInterface
classes.description: Java interface defining FTP client operations such as connect, copy, list, mode settings, and disconnect.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initializes an FTP connection to the specified server with provided credentials, port, and timeout.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies a file represented by an InputStream to a specified path with a given filename on the connected FTP server.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of filenames from the specified directory path on the FTP server.

methods.name: setBinaryTransfer
methods.description: Sets whether the transfer mode should be binary or ASCII.

methods.name: setPassiveMode
methods.description: Sets whether the FTP connection should use passive mode.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the currently open FTP connection.
